title: history/YYYY/YYYY-MM.json
description: One calendar month: the account valuations, trades, prices, FX rates and inflation-index values dated in it. A record's date decides its file (2026-09-30 goes in history/2026/2026-09.json). Records are sorted by date, then by ID. Keys: one valuation per account and date, one price per instrument and date, one FX rate per currency pair and date, one value per index and date; trades are keyed by account, date and id. How an account's value and net worth are worked out from these records is in README.md, How values are computed; how a trades account's holdings, cost and cash follow from its trades is in TRADES.md.

month.description: The month, the same as the file name.

trades.description: The trades of accounts with "valuation": "trades". Left out when empty.

valuation.description: What an account was worth on a date: a balance, or positions plus optional cash (an account can switch between the two over time). Values carry forward until the account's next valuation. One with neither is worth zero; one with both counts its balance. An account that records trades records only cash: positions listed in its valuation are a check against its trades (TRADES.md), and a balance isn't used.

balance.description: One amount in the account's currency, negative for debts.

cash.description: Cash held next to the positions, in the account's currency.

positions.description: Quantities held. Left out when empty.

flow.description: The net money added (+) or taken out (−) since the account's previous valuation, in the account's currency. Absent means unknown. The check-in fills it in from defaults that depend on the kind of account (PROGRESS.md); the sum of all flows over a period is what you saved. An account that records trades gets its flows from its trades and cash, and its flow is written for the record.

position.description: A quantity of an instrument held in an account, valued at the latest price on or before the date.

costBasis.description: The position's total purchase cost in the account's currency (valore di carico). Plans use it to estimate the tax on a sale; where it's missing, the plan's unrealizedGainShare estimate, or else the whole value counts as gain (with a warning).

trade.description: A buy, a sell, a dividend or another event in an account that records trades (TRADES.md). Amounts are in the account's currency unless stated otherwise. Which fields a type uses, and its cash effect when amount is left out: buy and sell: instrument, quantity, price and/or amount; fees, tax, settlement (−(quantity × price + fees + tax) for a buy, quantity × price − fees − tax for a sale). dividend: amount, or quantity and the dividend per unit as price; instrument, tax, fees. interest: amount; tax. fee: amount or fees; settlement. tax: amount or tax (a tax charged on its own, e.g. imposta di bollo); settlement. deposit, withdrawal: amount. transferIn, opening: instrument, quantity, cost (no cash effect). transferOut: instrument, quantity. split: instrument, ratio. quantity × price is converted at the latest FX rate on or before the trade date, and computed amounts are rounded to cents.

id.description: Unique among the account's trades on its date, stable across edits, so two identical trades on one day stay distinct and a trade edited on two devices merges as one. The app makes 8 random lowercase base32 characters; an imported trade gets a stable ID made from its row, so importing the file again finds it. Hand-written IDs can be any slug (buy-1).

type.description: What the trade does. transferIn and transferOut move securities between accounts or brokers; opening is a holding on the date the account's history starts.
type.$comment: Open enum: a type this version doesn't know is kept and pointed out; only its amount counts, in cash.

instrument.description: The instrument bought, sold, moved or split, or paying a dividend.

quantity.description: Units, always positive: the type says the direction.

currency.description: The price's currency. Default: the instrument's (the account's without an instrument).

amount.description: The cash effect on the account, in the account's currency, signed: negative for a buy, a fee, a tax or a withdrawal; positive for sale proceeds, dividends, interest and deposits. Net of fees and tax: what the cash actually changed by. Optional where it can be computed; when written, it wins. For a trade settled outside the account, what was paid or received there, signed the same way.

fees.description: Commissions, positive. Part of amount, and of a buy's purchase cost.

tax.description: Tax withheld, positive: on a sale's gain, a dividend or interest, or a transaction tax on a buy (part of its purchase cost). Part of amount.

cost.description: The total purchase cost carried in, for transferIn and opening. Without it the cost is unknown.

ratio.description: For split: new units per old unit, "2" for a 2-for-1 split, "0.1" for a 1-for-10 reverse split.

settlement.description: For buy, sell, fee and tax: where it was paid from or into. account (the default, left out): the account's cash. external: outside the account, e.g. gold bought from a dealer and paid from the bank. Such a trade doesn't change the account's cash; its amount is money added (a buy, a fee, a tax) or taken out (a sale).
settlement.$comment: Open enum: a value this version doesn't know counts as account.

price.description: An instrument's price on a date, per its unit.

fx.description: An exchange rate on a date, in the ECB convention: 1 base = rate × quote.

index.description: A consumer-price-index value: a country's all-items HICP from Eurostat, 2015 = 100 (hicp-it, hicp-de, hicp-ch, …), or the euro area's (hicp-ea). A monthly value is dated the last day of the month it measures and stored in that month's file, even when it's published later.
